strings.안녕하세요. %s…. 한동안 못 만날 줄 알았는데, 금방 만나네요. 무슨: Hello, %s... I thought we wouldn't meet for a while, but you're back already. Nothing's wrong, is it?
strings.무슨 일이 있는 그런 건 아닌데…, 다시 와야 할 것 같은 기분이 들었어: Nothing in particular... I just felt I should come back.
As it happens, I had something to tell you.
strings.이리스 님의 마음속에서 악의와 싸우고 있는 또 다른 마음을 찾아가 보세요: Visit the other part of Iris's heart, the one fighting malice within her mind.
...I think that part of her has something to say.
strings.그런 거라면 이리스에게 직접 묻는 게 나을 것 같은데…. 제가 한 번 불: Wouldn't it be better to ask Iris directly? I'll call her. We're connected.
strings.이리스, 이리스. 듣고 있으면 잠깐 나와서 이야기하지 않겠어?: Iris, Iris. If you can hear me, could you come out and talk for a moment?
strings.(아무리 기다려도 아무런 반응이 없다.): (No matter how long you wait, there is no response.)
strings.아무 때나 이야기할 수 있는 건 아니니…. 미뉴에트, 혹시 아는 거 있어: We can't talk whenever we want... Do you know anything, Minuet?
Really. I truly don't know anything else.
strings.네. 알았어요. 알려주셔서 감사해요. 무슨 일인지는 제가 직접 알아볼게요: All right. Thank you for telling me. I'll find out myself.
strings.제가 알고 있는 건 언제든지 말씀드릴게요. 새로운 이야깃거리가 있다면 늘: I'll always tell you what I know. Whenever there's something new. Oh, and...
strings.저기, 미뉴에트 설마 기억이 안나는 척을 하는 건가요?: Minuet, are you pretending not to remember?
No, I really forgot! I can't remember.
strings.지금은 제가 중요한 게 아니니 이리스 님의 마음속 세계에서 열심히 싸우고: I'm not what's important now. Go find the heart fighting so hard within Iris's inner world!
strings.지금은 오래 있어도 괜찮은 거야?: Is it all right for me to stay a while now?
strings.제 본체가 열심히 수련을 하고 있고, 모험가님께서 도움을 주셔서 이 안의: My true self is training hard, and with your help, the malice within is gradually weakening.
Though I can't let my guard down.
I heard you had something to say.
Her incarnation Minuet, to be precise...
She must have been worried about me.
Tell me anything you want. I'll listen.
strings.아니에요, 시간이 없어요. 제가 서두르지 않으면 겨우 잠재운 악의가 다시: No, there's no time. If I don't hurry, the malice I barely subdued might wake again.
strings.…저와 여행을 함께 했던 친구들을 기억하시나요?: ...Do you remember the friends who traveled with me?
strings.고마워요. 가능하시면 그들을 만나주시겠어요?: Thank you. Could you meet them, if possible?
Yes. Tell them Iris is well.
Your friends are my friends, too. Don't worry.
strings.그런데 전부를 만날 수 있을 것 같진 않아. 어디 있는지 모르는 사람도: But I don't think I can meet everyone. I don't know where some of them are...
strings.괜찮아요. 지엔디아에 계시는 분들 중에서 만날 수 있는 분에게만 다녀와주: That's all right. Just visit those in Jiendia you can find.
strings.(레비…. 레비는 별 일 없으면 엘리아스 왕성에 있는 것 같았으니 그곳으: (Levi... Usually at Elias Palace, if nothing's happened. Should I go there?)
strings.(그동안 이리스에게 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (You explain what has happened to Iris.)
So I'm visiting her old companions on her behalf.
strings.조에와 무웬이 이리스 님과 함께 있다니 다행입니다. 이렇게 소식을 전해주: I'm glad Zoe and Muwen are with her. Thank you for bringing the news.
strings.이리스 님께 많은 일이 있었군요. 그리고, 지금도 힘든 운명에 빠져 있고: So much has happened to Lady Iris. And she still faces a harsh fate.
strings.저도 돕고 싶지만, 제가 할 수 있는 게 없을 것 같아서 미안할 뿐입니다: I want to help, too, but I fear there's nothing I can do. I'm sorry.
strings.(레비가 잠시 생각에 빠진 것 같다.): (Levi seems lost in thought for a moment.)
I'm sorry I have nothing more to offer.
It's all right. Iris and I understand.
strings.혹시 다른 분들 소식을 알고 계신가요?: Have you heard anything of the others?
strings.죄송합니다. 저도 예전에 수소문했는데, 어디 계신지 모르겠습니다. 하지만: I'm sorry. I asked around before, but I don't know where they are. I'll tell you as soon as I find them.
I see. Until next time, Levi.
strings.혹시 그녀의 소식을 알고 계십니까?: Have you heard anything about her?
I'm sorry. Nothing at the moment.
strings.네, 알겠습니다. 마지막으로 하나만 더 물어도 되겠습니까?: I understand. May I ask one last question?
Iris asked me to meet those in Jiendia... Someone who comes to mind...
strings.흑월공주님은 괜찮습니다. 제가 얼마 전에 뵙고 왔는데, 건강을 많이 회복: The Dark Moon Princess is well. I saw her recently, and her health has improved considerably.
Oh, I'd like to see her. It's been a while. I'll go to Dark Moon Castle...
Travel safely. And give Lady Iris my regards.
strings.감히 이곳이 어디라고 들어와?!: How dare you enter this place?!
strings.(공주가 %s에게 활을 겨누고 있다. 예전에 만났을 때보다 더욱 위협적으: (The princess aims her bow at %s, looking even more threatening than on your previous visit.)
I'm glad, Princess. You look much healthier...
strings.무슨 소리야? 난 원래 건강했어. 그건 그렇고 넌 누구야? 날 알아?: What are you talking about? I've always been healthy. Who are you, anyway? Do you know me?
strings.아오이치에 사는 사람이라면 나를 모를 리가 없지만…. 넌 누구야?: Anyone from Aoich would know me... But who are you?
strings.헛, 소란이 일어서 뭔가 했더니 자네였군. 오랜만이네. 잘 지냈어?: Oh! I wondered what the commotion was. It's you. It's been a while. Have you been well?
strings.덕분에 잘 지냈네. 공주한테 해준 일도 고맙고…. 자네의 활약을 멀리서나: Very well, thanks to you. And thank you for helping my daughter... I've heard of your exploits, even from afar.
strings.아버님, 이 사람 아시나요? 멋대로 여기까지 들어왔어요. 보통 사람이라면: Father, do you know this person? They entered without permission. Though an ordinary person wouldn't even consider coming here.
My daughter, this is the one who helped you. In Midgard...
Oh! I'm sorry I didn't recognize you. How can I thank you?
strings.그때는 정신이 없어서 누가 구해주셨는지도 몰랐거든요. 머무는 곳을 알려주: I was so overwhelmed then that I didn't know who saved me. Tell me where you're staying, and I'll send a reward.
strings.딸. 저 사람과는 내가 잠시 할 이야기가 있으니 자리를 비켜주겠니?: Daughter, may we have a moment alone? There's something I need to discuss.
strings.성주님, 무슨 이야길 하실 건가요?: What did you want to say, my lord?
Isn't it obvious? My daughter's memories.
strings.공주가 보이지 않아서 한참 찾고 있을 때, 미드가르드에서 주점을 운영하는: While I was searching for her after she vanished, Shino, who runs a tavern in Midgard, brought her back.
strings.눈빛에 가득찬 공허함이 말해주듯 공주는 가족과 흑월성의 일 외에는 기억하: As the emptiness in her eyes showed, she remembered only her family and matters concerning Dark Moon Castle.
She couldn't remember Choen at all, despite their long time together.
strings.말 그대로 기억을 잃은 표정이었네. 자네가 난처해하는 걸 보니 다 알고: The very expression of someone who had lost memories. Your discomfort told me you knew about it.
strings.공주가 아오이치를 떠나기 전, 주민 하나가 자네가 공주를 만난 것 같다고: Before she left Aoich, a resident told me you seemed to have met her.
strings.길게 이야기할 필요는 없네. 공주가 선택한 결과니까. 내 딸은 언제나 옳: No need to explain at length. It was the result of her choice. My daughter always chooses rightly. She must have then, too.
strings.성주님! 말씀 중에 죄송합니다. 제가 떠오른 게 있어서 볼 일을 보고 빨: My lord! Forgive the interruption. I've thought of something. I'll go take care of it and return quickly.
Hehe. That expression suggests you've found a good approach.
It won't be perfect, but it may help a little.
strings.감히 이곳이 어디라고 들어… 어? 저번에 오신 그분이군요. 또 흑월성에: How dare you enter... Oh? It's you from before. Is something happening at Dark Moon Castle again?
My beloved daughter, I asked this person to come.
strings.아버님, 저도 아버님을 사랑하지만 갑자기 나타나 과격하게 껴안으시려고 하: Father, I love you too, but appearing suddenly and trying to hug me so fiercely...
strings.(공주가 성주를 향해 활을 겨눈다. 딱 봐도 한두번도 아닌지 무척 익숙해: (The princess aims her bow at her father. The practiced movement suggests this has happened many times.)
I won't fall for it again! I already have your eye drops!
strings.쳇…, 어쩔 수 없지. 아, 사랑하는 딸, 어디 가지 말고 %s의 이야기: Tsk... No helping it. My beloved daughter, stay and hear what %s has to say.
strings.제가 들을만한 재미있는 이야기인가요?: Something interesting for me to hear?
strings.도움이 될만한 물건을 구해왔어요. 공주님이 그냥 가지고 계시면 될 것 같: I brought something that may help. You only need to keep it with you, Princess.
What's it called? It feels full of primal power.
A Memory Fragment. Just keep it with you.
Yes. It should react only to someone who has lost memories. Probably...
So you're not quite certain, either.
strings.(공주가 의심스러운 표정으로 기억의 파편을 바라본다. 성주가 고개를 끄덕: (The princess regards the Memory Fragment suspiciously. At her father's nod, she takes it in hand.)
strings.(흑월공주의 손 안에서 기억의 파편이 녹아 사라진다. 뭔가 느낀 공주의: (The fragment dissolves in her hand. Sensing something, the princess slowly grows pale.)
I feel like I've been forgetting something all this time... But I don't know what...
strings.(흑월공주의 표정이 다시 돌아온다. 어느 정도 안정이 된 것 같다.): (Her expression returns to normal. She seems somewhat steadier.)
strings.그래. 맞아. 당신은 이리스를 찾기 위해서 여행을 했던 사람이었어. 그래: Yes. That's right. You were traveling to find Iris. Did you find her?
strings.그래? 그렇다 한들 난 앞으로도 이리스를 이해하지 못할 거야. 이해하고: I see. Even so, I'll never understand Iris. I don't want to. And...
strings.공주, 이제 기억이 좀 나니?: Princess, do you remember a little now?
strings.네, 아버님. 전부 다는 아니지만…. 잊고 있는 사람이 있었던 기분이 들: Yes, Father. Not everything... But I feel like there's someone I've forgotten.
strings.(잠시 할 말을 잃은 공주의 눈가에 눈물이 고이기 시작한다.): (The princess falls silent, and tears begin to gather in her eyes.)
strings.%s, 당신 말이야…. 내게 왜 이런 걸 가지고 온 거야? 내가 왜 갑자: %s... Why did you bring me this? Why am I suddenly feeling this way?!
strings.아버님, 아버님. 제가 잊고 있는 사람이 누군지 아시나요? 네? 알 것: Father, Father... Do you know whom I've forgotten? I feel like I know, but the name... I can't say the name...
Daughter, you should rest today. Go inside.
strings.(공주가 안으로 들어가자 성주의 눈빛이 쓸쓸하게 변한다.): (Once she leaves, loneliness enters her father's gaze.)
strings.이제 알겠네. 내 딸이 왜 그 아이를 기억하지 못하는지…. 그 아이가 계: Now I understand why she can't remember that child... I don't know what contract was made, but the price was my daughter's memories...
How cruel. How did it come to this...?
Thank you, anyway. You helped recover at least part of her memories... When you return, give my regards to Iris... To Goddess Iris.
strings.엘리아스 왕성과 흑월성에 다녀왔어. 다들 잘 있고, 안부를 전해달라 했어: I visited Elias Palace and Dark Moon Castle. Everyone is well and sends their regards.
I also brought the princess a Memory Fragment from Dragon Valley...
If I'd done better, perhaps the Dark Moon Princess wouldn't have suffered like that...
strings.이 세계에 내려진 가혹한 운명이 모두를 그렇게 만든 것 같은 기분이 들어: I feel as though the cruel fate laid upon this world has done this to everyone.
strings.그저 나쁜 일이 일어난 것뿐이야. 모두에게서 일어날 수 있는 그런 나쁜: Something bad happened. The kind of bad thing that could happen to anyone...
strings.약한 소리 하지 마. 내가 이리스를 돕는 것도, 내가 어떤 기억의 단편을: Don't give in to despair. Is helping you my fate? Is forgetting fragments of my memories fate, too? It isn't.
strings.후우…. 어쩔 수 없는 것도, 본체가 노력하고 있다는 것도, 지금 나에게: Sigh... I know there are things you can't help, that your true self is trying, and that the one speaking to me is the vulnerable part of your heart.
But hearing only despair wears me down, too. Don't worry about it too much.
strings.아직 이리스의 본체를 제대로 만난 건 아니지만, 조만간 본체를 만나러 갈: I haven't properly met your true self yet, but I'll come soon. I'd like us to meet properly then.
strings.미리 말씀드리지 못한 게 있는데…. 힘이 완벽해지기 전까지는 본체를 만나: There's something I couldn't tell you earlier... I don't think you can meet my true self until my power is complete.
strings.정신적으로 연결되어 있는데, 지금 불안정한 상태라 가까이 있으면 흐트러질: We're mentally connected. In this unstable state, being too close could disrupt that connection.
strings.괜찮아. 그럼 나중에 다시 올게. 이리스의 마음뿐만 아니라 본체를 만나러: It's all right. I'll come again later. I'll work hard until I can meet your true self, not only your heart.
Yes. I'll do my best, too.
strings.너란 마음은 정말로 우스워. 너를 만나기 위해 오랜 시간을 희생한 인간에: What a ridiculous heart you are. Hiding that from a human who sacrificed so much time to meet you? Shall I go tell them?
It's something they mustn't know. For their own sake.
strings.그건 그 인간이 판단할 일 아니야?: Isn't that for the human to decide?
strings.답을 하지 않는 걸 보니 양심이라도 찔리나 보네? 그럼 내가 다시 나타날: No answer? Your conscience must be pricking you. Then it's my turn to rise again!
strings.이리스라는 신의 내면 속에서 누가 이기나 해보자고!!: Let's see who wins within the heart of the god called Iris!
